name: Freesurfer Labels to 3D Surfaces
summary: Creates 3D surface meshes for the FreeSurfer aparc+aseg labels (cortical and subcortical regions) with VTK marching cubes, in vtk, ply or stl format.
description: Converts mri/aparc+aseg.mgz to NIfTI with FreeSurfer mri_label2vol, then builds a smoothed mesh for each of a fixed list of subcortical and Desikan-Killiany cortical labels with VTK, naming and colouring them from the FreeSurfer colour lookup table. Use it to visualise a FreeSurfer segmentation in 3D. The job checks for a fixed number of output files and fails if any are missing.

outputs.description: One surface mesh per FreeSurfer label, with colour and name information.

failure_modes.cause: Not every expected label surface was produced.
failure_modes.fix: Check that aparc+aseg.mgz contains the standard FreeSurfer labels.
